messages.subject: firma status?
parts:
Hi. I'm trying to run firma on a set of 49 exon arrays. It seems to
be using a gross amount of memory (> 10G). I've seen some posts
about this from back in March and I'm just wondering what the status
of it is.

I think one of my problems is that I didn't set it to the 'core' set
for the human exon array, so maybe that would help somewhat.

Cheers,
Mark

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] firma status?
parts:
Hi Mark,

does it increase linearly with the number of arrays? I checked the
code in fit() of the FirmaModel and I think it because each of the
FIRMA score files caches the results.

If you run fit() for the first, say 5 arrays, then I suspect that you
will see that the objectSize() of the first 5 FirmaFile:s will be
large than for the non-fitted ones. Example:

fs <- getFirmaScores(firma);
fit(firma, verbose=-8)
<Break after 5 arrays>
for (kk in 1:10) print(objectSize(getFile(fs, kk)))

I've fixed this and uploaded a patch. So, do:

library(aroma.affymetrix)
downloadPackagePatch("aroma.affymetrix")

and let me know if it helps.

Cheers

Henrik
